name: Ecology
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the Creator of the earth and all its creatures, establishing mankind with dominion over the natural world as His image-bearers. This stewardship includes responsible use of the land and its resources, as God provided plants for food and commanded care in harvesting. The Bible also instructs respect for living creatures, such as sparing a mother bird when taking young or eggs, and warns against polluting the land, emphasizing the sacredness of God's creation and the human responsibility to maintain its purity.
